وَٱلطُّورِ
By the mount
By the Mount [Sinai]
Allah swore by the mountain on which He spoke to Moses (peace be upon him).
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالطُّورِ
وَكِتَٰبࣲ مَّسۡطُورࣲ
And [by] a Book inscribed
by the Book inscribed
And he swore by the Qur’ān which is a written book
وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ
فِي رَقࣲّ مَّنشُورࣲ
In parchment spread open
on an unrolled parchment
On a spread-open paper.
فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ
وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
And [by] the frequented House
by the House greatly frequented
And He swore by the House in the heavens which the angels in the heavens inhabit by worshipping Allah.
وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ
وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
And [by] the heaven raised high
by the vault raised high
And He swore by the sky.
وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ
وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
And [by] the sea filled [with fire]
by the surging sea
And He swore by the sea filled with water.
وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ
إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ
Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur
indeed your Lord’s punishment will surely befall
O Messenger, the punishment of your Lord will definitely occur on the disbelievers.
إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ
مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعࣲ
Of it there is no preventer
There is none who can avert it
There is nobody to repel it from them and save them from it befalling them.
مَا لَهُ مِنْ دَافِعٍ
يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرࣰ ا
On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
On the day when the sky whirls violently
The day in which the heavens (or sky) will move violently, in full accordance with the arrival of the Hour.
يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا
وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرࣰ ا
And the mountains will pass on, departing
and the mountains move with an awful motion
And the mountains will travel from their places.
وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
فَوَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
Then woe, that Day, to the deniers
woe to the deniers on that day
So destruction and loss on that day will be for those who deny the punishment Allah promised the disbelievers.
فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضࣲ يَلۡعَبُونَ
Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves
—those who play around in vain talk
Those who are in their discourse in falsehood, playing. They do not care about resurrection or being raised.
الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say]
the day when they will be shoved forcibly toward the fire of hell, [and told]
The day they will be pushed with force and harshness towards the fire of hell.
يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
This is the Fire which you used to deny
‘This is the Fire which you used to deny
And it will be said to them in rebuke, “This is the fire you used to deny when your messengers used to warn you of it.
هَٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
Then is this magic, or do you not see
Is this, then, [also] magic, or is it you who do not perceive
Is this punishment which you see magic, or are you not seeing it?
أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَا أَمْ أَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
[Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do
Enter it, and it will be the same for you whether you are patient or impatient. You are only being requited for what you used to do.’

Taste the heat of this fire and suffer it. Be patient over suffering its heat or not; your patience or impatience is all the same. You will not be rewarded today except with the disbelief and sins you used to commit in the world”.
اصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَعِيمࣲ
Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure
Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and bliss
Those who are mindful of their Lord by carrying out His commands and refraining from His prohibitions will be in gardens and a great pleasure which will never end.
إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
rejoicing because of what their Lord has given them, and that their Lord has saved them from the punishment of hell

They will be enjoying the pleasures of food, drink and marriage that Allah will have given them, and their Lord (may He be glorified), protected them from the punishment of hell. Hence, they were successful through achieving their desired pleasures and by being protected from difficulties.
فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
[They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do
[They will be told:] ‘Enjoy your food and drink, [as a reward] for what you used to do.’
It will be said to them: “Eat and drink of what your souls desire, in satisfaction without fearing harm or pain from what you eat and drink, as a reward for your excellent actions in the world”.
كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّصۡفُوفَةࣲۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ
They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes
They will be reclining on arrayed couches, and We will wed them to big-eyed houris
Reclining on adorned thrones which have been lined up, and I will marry them to fair women with beautiful wide eyes.
مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ

And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained

The faithful and their descendants who followed them in faith—We will make their descendants join them, and We will not stint anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Every person is hostage to what he has earned

And those who brought faith and whose children followed them in faith - I will join their children with them so that they are pleased with them, even though they did not reach their actions. And I will not decrease anything from the reward of their actions. Every person will be held for the bad actions he earned; nobody else will bear any of his actions.
وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ وَلَحۡمࣲ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire
We will provide them with fruits and meat, such as they desire
And I will provide these people of Paradise with different fruits and I will provide them with all the meat they desire.
وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا لَّا لَغۡوࣱ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمࣱ
They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin
There they will pass from hand to hand a cup wherein there will be neither any vain talk nor sinful speech
They will give to one another cups of wine, bearing no resemeblness to the wine of this world, free from intoxication and that which arises from it, such as false speech.
يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانࣱ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ
There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected
They will be waited upon by their youths, as if they were guarded pearls
And servants will circle amongst them, as though they are protected pearls.
۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَكْنُونٌ
وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other
They will turn to one another, questioning each other
The people of Paradise will turn to one another, asking each other about their condition in the world.
وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah]
They will say, ‘Indeed, aforetime, we used to be apprehensive about our families
They will respond to them: “We were, in the world amongst our families, fearful of Allah’s punishment.
قَالُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire
But Allah showed us favour and He saved us from the punishment of the [infernal] miasma
So Allah favoured us by guiding us to Islam, and He protected us from the punishment which is extremely hot.
فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ
إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful
We used to supplicate Him aforetime. Indeed He is the All-benign, the All-merciful.’

We used to worship Him in our worldly life and we used to pray to Him to protect us from the fire of hell. He is Beneficent to His servants and Merciful to them. Part of His beneficence and mercy upon us is that He guided us to faith, entered us into Paradise and distanced us from the fire.”
إِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ
فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman
So admonish. By your Lord’s blessing, you are not a soothsayer, nor mad
So remind through the Qur’ān, O Messenger, for you are not, by the faith and intelligence Allah has favoured you with, a soothsayer with visions of jinns nor are you insane.
فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرࣱ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time
Do they say, ‘[He is] a poet, for whom we await a fatal accident’
Do these idolaters say: “Muhammad is not a messenger, but he is a poet whom we await death to seize so we can be relieved of him”?
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ
قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters
Say, ‘Wait! I too am waiting along with you.’
O Messenger, say to them: “Await my death, and I will await the punishment which will befall you due to denying me”.
قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people
Is it their intellect which prompts them to [say] this, or are they a rebellious lot

Or do their minds tell them to say: “He is a soothsayer and insane?” So they combine what cannot gather in one person, but rather they are a people who trespass the bounds, hence they do not return to any sacred law or intellect.
أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهَٰذَا ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe
Do they say, ‘He has improvised it [himself]?’ Rather, they have no faith

Or do they say: “Muhammad fabricated this Qur’ān and nothing has been revealed to him?” He has not fabricated it, but rather they are too arrogant to have faith in it, so they say: “He has fabricated it”.
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ ۚ بَلْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful
Let them bring a discourse like it, if they are truthful
So let them produce a narrative like it, even if it has been fabricated, if they are true in their claim that he has fabricated it.
فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِثْلِهِ إِنْ كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ
أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]
Were they created from nothing? Or are they [their own] creators

Or have they been created without a creator to create them? Or are they their own creators? The existence of a creation without a creator or a creation which creates itself is impossible, so why do they not worship their own creator?
أَمْ خُلِقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ
أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain
Did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they have no certainty

Or did they create the heavens and the earth? But they do not have conviction that Allah is their Creator, if they had been convinced of that, they would have declared His oneness and brought faith in His Messenger.
أَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۚ بَلْ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]
Do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or do they control [them]

Or do they have the treasures of your Lord’s provision to give to whom they wish, and prophethood to give to or stop from whom they want? Or are they the controllers and disposers according to their wish?
أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ
أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمࣱ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority
Do they have a ladder [leading up to heaven] whereby they eavesdrop? If so, let their eavesdropper produce a manifest authority

Or do they have a ladder with which to climb to the sky in which they listen to Allah’s revelation which He sends to tell them they are on the truth? So let the one who listens amongst them to that revelation bring a clear proof to affirm you in your claim that you are on truth.
أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
Or has He daughters while you have sons
Does He have daughters while you have sons
Or does He (may He be glorified) have daughters which you dislike, whilst you have sons which you love?
أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ
أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down
Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are [wary of] being weighed down with debt
Or do you, O Messenger, seek a wage from them for what you convey to them from their Lord, due to which they are burdened with something they cannot bear?
أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ
أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down
Do they have [access to] the Unseen, which they write down
Or do they have knowledge of the Ghaib, so that they write for people what they learn from the Ghaib and inform them of what they want therefrom?
أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ اۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan
Do they seek to outmaneuver [Allah]? But it is the faithless who are the outmaneuvered ones
Or do these deniers intend to plot against you and your religion. Trust in Allah, as those who disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger are the ones who will be plotted against, not you.
أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ
أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him
Do they have any god other than Allah? Clear is Allah of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]
Or do they have a true god besides Allah? Pure and exalted is Allah from the partner they attribute to him. None of what was mentioned has happened or is even thinkable.
أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ
And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up
Were they to see a fragment falling from the sky, they would say, ‘A cumulous cloud.’
And if they see a piece of the sky falling, they will say: “This is a cloud which is piled up on each other as usual”. So they do not take heed or believe.
وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا سَحَابٌ مَرْكُومٌ
فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible
So leave them until they encounter the day when they will be thunderstruck
So leave them, O Messenger, in their stubbornness and denial until they meet their day in which they will be punished, which is the day of judgment.
فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped
the day when their guile will not avail them in any way, nor will they be helped
The day when their plot will neither help them a little or a lot, nor will they be helped by being saved from the punishment.
يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ
وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know
Indeed there is a punishment besides that for those who do wrong, but most of them do not know

And for those who wronged themselves through idolatry and sins is a punishment before the punishment of the afterlife: in this life through being killed and imprisoned, and in the Transitory Stage through punishment of the grave. However, most of them do not know that, which is why they remain on their disbelief.
وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise
So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, for indeed you fare before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise [at dawn]
Be patient, O Messenger, on the decree of your Lord and His divine law, as you are in My sight and protection. And glorify and praise your Lord when you stand from your sleep.
وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars
and also glorify Him during the night and at the receding of the stars
And at night, glorify your Lord and pray to Him, and pray the Fajr prayer after the stars have set due to daylight.
وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ
